motion.text:
Motion spec (plays on these artboards)

Hero
• Photo: slow 26s push-in, centred on the tree
• Warm light pool drifts across the concrete (14s loop)
• Copy rises in, staggered 0.1 → 0.8s
• Copper hairline grows out of the trust line: the thread that carries into the next section
• Leaf sway needs a short video loop (4–6s, <1.5MB) — not in this mock

Idea → production
• The branch in the photo becomes the copper line; the line draws down the spine
• Each step card rises as the line reaches it (scroll-linked in the build)
• A small light travels the line on a 7s loop
• The last node (Improve with care) pulses: the product is live and still growing
• In the build: left headline is sticky while the cards scroll

All motion off under prefers-reduced-motion.

Before shipping
• Regenerate the hero photo at ≥2400px wide (this crop is 837px)
• Arabic/RTL: mirror the spine to the right side

motionPlan.text:
Motion plan for the whole page

Principle: one quiet motion idea per section, all tied to the copper thread. Transform and opacity only, 60fps, nothing loops loudly.

Global
• Header hides on scroll down, returns on scroll up
• Sections reveal once as they enter (Framer Motion whileInView, 0.8–1s, soft ease-out, 60–120ms stagger)
• Optional smooth scroll (Lenis), off on touch devices

1 Hero
• Headline rises line by line under a mask
• Photo push-in + drifting sunlight; later a 5s leaf-sway loop

2 Selected work
• Tiles slide in with a slight horizontal parallax (each tile at a different speed)
• Hover: tile lifts, a muted video loop plays
• Numbers count up once when visible

3 From idea to production
• Spine draws as you scroll (useScroll → pathLength)
• Each card rises when the line reaches its node
• Headline stays sticky; last node pulses

4 Founder
• Small portrait wipes up from the bottom and settles from 110% scale
• Quote fades in after the photo

5 Ways to work
• Rows open on hover/focus with a height + fade animation
• Button arrow nudges on hover

6 FAQ → closing call → footer
• Accordion eases open
• Copper thread grows across the closing call and ends in a pulsing node
• Tree photo settles out of a slight zoom
• Footer clock ticks live

Accessibility
• prefers-reduced-motion switches every animation off (already in these boards)
• No motion blocks reading or clicking

Layout

• Square corners everywhere, hairline dividers
• Section rhythm: dark → cream → dark → split → sand → cream → dark → footer

v2Notes.text:
v2 page, top to bottom (8 sections → 6)
1. Short hero
2. Selected work
3. From idea to production (board sits in the tree column)
4. Founder
5. Ways to work together
6. FAQ → closing call → footer

Removed and why
• “Clear thinking. Beautiful execution.” + 4 icons: says nothing the work and process don’t show better
• Approach (4 steps): now lives inside From idea to production, same copy
• Private by nature: replaced by an actual project

Changed
• Founder: compact band (460px, was 760): head-and-shoulders portrait, founder-note quote, UK · 4 languages; the full story lives on /mahmoud
• Ways to work: 4 equal text cards → one open row at a time, outcome + CTA on the open row
• FAQ: real accordion, first answer open
• Closing call: the tree returns as a bookend; the copper thread ends in a pulsing node
• Footer: headline B as the tagline, live UK time

Draft copy of mine to approve: “Every product grows from a single idea.”, its intro line, “Your product starts here.”, “Not sure which fits?”, “Meet the founder”.

mobileNotes.text:
Mobile (390) — what changes from desktop

Same 6 sections, same copy, same order.

• Header: logo, EN / ع and a menu button; the menu opens full-screen with big nav links and the CTA (tap it)
• Hero: photo on top, statement below it, so text never sits on the image; headline 34px over 4 lines
• Selected work: the four tiles become a sideways swipe strip with snap and progress dashes; numbers go 2-up
• From idea to production: the line leaves the branch, runs back to the left edge and becomes the spine; each step card stacks its mini screen under the text
• Founder: small portrait beside name and role, then headline, quote, facts 2-up
• Ways to work: tap to open a row (no hover on phones); full-width “Discuss this route”
• FAQ and closing call: full-width buttons, 52px CTA

In the build, not in this mock
• A slim “Start a conversation” bar slides up from the bottom once the hero is scrolled past, hides near the closing call
• Header hides on scroll down, returns on scroll up

Motion on phones: lighter. Keep the hero push-in, text rises, spine drawing on scroll and accordions. Drop tile parallax and hover effects. All off under reduce-motion.

Touch targets are 44px or larger throughout.
